notes: Objects referenced by the Phase 07 policies. Built in the portal (first of their kind) and found by name at deploy time.

authenticationStrength.name: AS-Onboarding-Passkey-or-TAP
authenticationStrength.purpose: Only used to register security information. Joiners use their one-time TAP; people with a passkey use it; during the passkey rollout, people who only have Authenticator push (password + push) can still add a passkey. Remove 'password,microsoftAuthenticatorPush' once passkey adoption reaches 100%.

authenticationContext.description: Required when activating Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator in PIM. CA102 demands a phishing-resistant passkey every time.

adminOnboarding.name: GRP-CA-Exclude-AdminOnboarding
adminOnboarding.description: TEMPORARY exclusion from CA100 while a new admin account registers its first passkey with a TAP. Remove the same day. Flagged by 05-Test-ConditionalAccess.ps1 if not empty.

ring0.name: GRP-ASG-CA-Ring0
ring0.description: Conditional Access rollout ring 0: the IAM team. New workforce policies are enforced here first.

2.who: + the licensed cohort, spanning every department and office
